concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading both GSM8K and MiniGrid datasets with a cap of ≤ 500 examples each. T010 only implements GSM8K download and places the script in `code/src/data/download.py` instead of the required path, leaving MiniGrid unimplemented and violating Data Hygiene (Constitution Principle III).

FR-002 mandates generation of ground‑truth token sequences and per‑token validity labeling. The tasks list merely notes T013‑T019 as “remain checked” without concrete task definitions or deliverables, effectively dropping the required baseline generation and labeling work.

FR-003 demands capture of per‑layer probability distributions and Shannon entropy for every token. No explicit tasks are defined for this; T022‑T027 are only referenced as “remain checked”, leaving the entropy‑calculation requirement uncovered.

FR-004 requires fitting a Mixed‑Effects Logistic Regression (GLMM) and reporting coefficients, AUC‑ROC, etc. The tasks are marked as checked but lack concrete implementation steps, deliverables, or verification scripts, resulting in a missing analysis pipeline.
FR-005 (sensitivity‑analysis threshold sweep) is not mapped to any concrete task; the existing T030a‑T036 entries do not mention a sweep routine or reporting of false‑positive/false‑negative rates.
FR-006 (multiple‑comparison correction) is absent from the task list; no task specifies applying Bonferroni or Benjamini‑Hochberg correction to regression p‑values.

FR-007 requires processing intermediate‑state extraction in batches of exactly 50 tokens and raising `ConnectionError`/`FileNotFoundError` on dataset load failures. T009’s `stream_batch` description does not enforce the 50‑token limit nor specify the required error handling, constituting a weakening of the functional requirement.
Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) is violated: the required `requirements.txt` file does not exist at the specified path, breaking the reproducible‑build guarantee.
Constitution Principle I is also violated by the absence of `pyproject.toml`, `ruff.toml`, and `.black.toml`, which are required for version‑discipline and tooling configuration.
Constitution Principle VII (Ground‑Truth Dependency Discipline) is breached: `data/canonical_ground_truth.jsonl` is missing, preventing any downstream validity labeling.

The plan specifies using Qwen1.5‑0.5B, while FR‑002 explicitly requires a Llama‑2‑7B (or 1.5B) model. This model mismatch weakens the functional requirement and conflicts with the constitution’s Ground‑Truth Dependency Discipline.

The download script’s location (`code/src/data/download.py`) does not match the required path (`projects/.../code/src/data/download.py`), and MiniGrid handling is absent, violating the specification’s path expectations and Data Hygiene.
